title: AP Chemistry Independent Foundation Study Library
description: An original text-first nine-chapter study library paired with the internal AP Chemistry foundation pilot. It supports retrieval, calculation setup, model analysis, and evidence-based feedback without reproducing protected course or assessment content.

blueprint.cedEffectiveLabel: Fall 2024 Course Framework V.1; current public reference reviewed 2026-08-20.
blueprint.officialSectionOne: 60 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes; 50% of the official exam score.
blueprint.officialSectionTwo: 7 free-response questions in 105 minutes; 50% of the official exam score.
blueprint.pilotAlignment: 700-item internal foundation sampler across nine official units; 140 five-item banks; six chemistry science practices; five layered practice angles; data-interpretation, argumentation, model-translation, and method-design synthesis; text-first chapters; no FRQ scoring or laboratory competency claim.

bigIdeas.label: Structure of Matter
bigIdeas.description: Atoms and molecules have structures that determine how they interact and transform.

bigIdeas.label: Properties of Matter
bigIdeas.description: Chemical and physical properties emerge from interactions among particles.

bigIdeas.label: Chemical Reactions
bigIdeas.description: Chemical reactions involve rearrangements of atoms and changes in energy and matter.

bigIdeas.label: Kinetics
bigIdeas.description: Reaction rates depend on molecular collisions, pathways, and energy barriers.

bigIdeas.label: Thermodynamics
bigIdeas.description: Energy changes and entropy help determine the favorability of processes.

bigIdeas.label: Equilibrium
bigIdeas.description: Reversible processes reach dynamic balances described by quantitative relationships.

bigIdeas.label: Acids and Bases
bigIdeas.description: Proton-transfer equilibria and aqueous structure explain acid-base behavior.

sciencePractices.label: Models and Representations
sciencePractices.description: Create, interpret, and translate among particle, symbolic, mathematical, and graphical models.

sciencePractices.label: Question and Method
sciencePractices.description: Design investigations, identify variables and controls, and evaluate methods for chemical questions.

sciencePractices.label: Representing Data and Phenomena
sciencePractices.description: Represent and describe chemical observations, data patterns, and changes at multiple scales.

sciencePractices.label: Model Analysis
sciencePractices.description: Analyze models, assumptions, limitations, and changes in chemical systems.

sciencePractices.label: Mathematical Routines
sciencePractices.description: Apply quantitative relationships, units, proportional reasoning, and chemical calculations.

sciencePractices.label: Argumentation
sciencePractices.description: Make and justify claims with chemical evidence, principles, and logical reasoning.
